VERSION = 1,

/*
 * Burris Quality of Life - sandbox options.
 *
 * Every option declared here MUST also appear in
 *   media/lua/shared/BQoL/BQoL_Settings.lua
 * with the same default value. That table is what the mod actually reads, so an
 * option missing from it resolves to nil at runtime instead of its default.
 * tools/lint.sh enforces the pairing.
 *
 * Labels/tooltips come from Translate/<LANG>/Sandbox.json as:
 *   page    -> Sandbox_<page>
 *   label   -> Sandbox_<translation>
 *   tooltip -> Sandbox_<translation>_tooltip
 *
 * The three craft recipes this mod adds (clean a bandage with alcohol,
 * disinfect a rag with cologne or perfume, cut a sheet from old clothing) are
 * script-defined and have no toggle -- they are additive recipes that change
 * nothing unless used.
 */

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ prying */

option BurrisQoL.PryEnabled
{
    type = boolean,
    default = true,

    page = BurrisQoL,
    translation = BurrisQoL_PryEnabled,
}
